programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Rule: Never keep a gift for yourself, unless ... Margreet has asked a robot bat for her birthday. If Floor sees the kitten, she also wants one, but that is not allowed by her mother. Floor therefore decides to secretly try Margreet's kitten at home. / Regel: Hou nooit een cadeau voor jezelf, tenzij... Margreet heeft een robotkatje voor haar verjaardag gevraagd. Als Floor het katje ziet wil ze er ook eentje, maar dat mag niet van haar moeder. Floor besluit daarom het katje van Margreet thuis stiekem even uit te proberen.

programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Rule: You should never invite handsome colleagues to your home, unless ... Floor's father has invited a female colleague for dinner. Soon the mother of Floor is sticky and the atmosphere is so tense that Floor and Kees are sitting at the table with a held breath. / Regel: Je moet nooit knappe collegas uitnodigen bij je thuis, tenzij... De vader van Floor heeft een vrouwelijke collega uitgenodigd voor het avondeten. Al snel is de moeder van Floor stikjaloers en de sfeer zo gespannen, dat Floor en Kees met ingehouden adem aan tafel zitten.

programme.title: In other words / Met andere woorden
programme.desc: Sarah and Thomas tell in colors, but especially in scents about a mysterious bacterium in girls ... / Sarah en Thomas vertellen in kleuren, maar vooral in geuren over een geheimzinnige bacterie in Meisjes...

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: There are strange noises and smoke from the basement. Tess is convinced that there is a dangerous loekedoe monster. Everyone believes her and is afraid of the monster. At the same time the school is full of waste. Soekie wants to motivate all students to clean up, but nobody responds to her call. Soekie calls in Tess's help. Tess says that the Loekedoe monster does not like waste. Because the Brollers are shocked by the monster, they start to clean up the school. / Er komen vreemde geluiden en rook uit de kelder. Tess is overtuigd dat er een gevaarlijk Loekedoesmonster zit. Iedereen gelooft haar en heeft schrik voor het monster. Op hetzelfde moment ligt de school vol afval. Soekie wil alle leerlingen motiveren om mee op te ruimen, maar niemand geeft gehoor aan haar oproep. Soekie roept de hulp van Tess in. Tess vertelt dat het Loekedoesmonster niet van afval houdt. Omdat de Brollers schrik hebben van het monster beginnen ze de school op te ruimen.

programme.title: Grizzy and De Lemmings / Grizzy en de lemmings
programme.desc: Funny animation series about the Beer Grizzy, whose quiet life is thoroughly disturbed by a group of annoying Lemmings - on adventure in China / Grappige animatiereeks over de beer Grizzy, wiens rustige leven grondig verstoord wordt door een groep vervelende lemmings - op avontuur in China

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Arno finally wants to make a cool invention so that he can be proud of himself. He would like to invent a telephoto -time machine. Geert wants to do Arno a favor and makes him believe that the mixer in the kitchen is a telephoto -time machine. To make this plan succeed, all Hoppers must play the game. / Arno wil eindelijk een coole uitvinding doen, zodat hij trots op zichzelf kan zijn. Hij wil graag een teletijdmachine uitvinden. Geert wil Arno een plezier doen en doet hem geloven dat de mixer in de keuken een teletijdmachine is. Om dit plan te laten lukken, moeten alle Hoppers het spel meespelen.

programme.title: The Athena / The Athena
programme.desc: After a fight with a renowned designer, the young model Nyela Malik can put a line through her career. She decides to change course and start designing clothes herself. Nyela is admitted to The Athena, a very prominent art academy in London, and is surrounded by very creative students. She tries to find her way in this challenging place. / Na een ruzie met een gerenommeerde ontwerper, kan het jonge model Nyela Malik een streep zetten door haar carrière. Ze besluit het roer om te gooien en zelf kleding te gaan ontwerpen. Nyela wordt toegelaten tot The Athena, een zeer vooraanstaande kunstacademie in Londen, en wordt daar omringd door zeer creatieve studenten. Op deze uitdagende plek probeert ze haar weg te vinden.

programme.title: 3Hz / 3Hz
programme.desc: Sammy is in a plight. Noor makes an important discovery and Patricia confronts Thomas with the behavior of his son. / Sammy bevindt zich in een benarde positie. Noor doet een belangrijke ontdekking en Patricia confronteert Thomas met het gedrag van zijn zoon.

programme.title: Campus 12: Compilation / Campus 12: compilatie
programme.desc: The dark rose cruisers discover that Noah and Sam have the only real stone of creation and have everything, but then everything, for it to get it in their possession. Noah and Sam are dragged even deeper into the mysterious world of alchemy and astronomy in an age -old underground course system. They get help from an unexpected corner and end up on the life -threatening path to the stone of the souls ... / De duistere Rozenkruisers ontdekken dat Noah en Sam de enige echte Steen der Schepping in handen hebben en hebben er alles, maar dan ook echt alles, voor over om die in hun bezit te krijgen. Noah en Sam worden in een eeuwenoud ondergronds gangenstelsel nog dieper meegesleurd in de mysterieuze wereld van alchemie en astronomie. Ze krijgen er hulp uit onverwachte hoek en belanden er op het levensgevaarlijke pad naar de Steen der Zielen...

The Runkst-Hasselt church choir, conducted by Sister Hilde Meykens, provides the Zang.organist is Jos Vanreppelen. / De eucharistieviering komt vanuit het Woonzorgcentrum Immadi in Hasselt. Het thema van de viering is: Geef ons meer geloof.Voorganger is Marcel Vanheusden. Het Kerkkoor Runkst-Hasselt, o.l.v. zuster Hilde Meykens, verzorgt de zang.Organist is Jos Vanreppelen.

programme.title: Atelier Cuvelier / Atelier Cuvelier
programme.desc: Art touches. You probably already know that. But how do artists do that? Michèle Cuvelier wants to unravel the secret of their creation. That's why she opens a studio. That is the place where art arises. Every week she invites an artist to Deep Dives in their creation process. How do they create? What inspires? What is blocking? In short: how does their brain crack? Michèle Makers, Metier and Magic dismantles with uncut curiosity. Welcome to the head of strong artists. Welcome to Atelier Cuvelier. / Kunst raakt. Dat weet je allicht al. Maar hoe flikken kunstenaars dat? Michèle Cuvelier wil het geheim van hun schepping ontrafelen. Daarom opent ze een atelier. Dat is de plek waar kunst ontstaat. Elke week nodigt ze een kunstenaar uit om te deep diven in hun maakproces. Hoe creëren ze? Wat inspireert? Wat blokkeert? Kortom: hoe knettert hun brein? Met onversneden nieuwsgierigheid ontmantelt Michèle makers, metier en magie. Welkom in het hoofd van straffe kunstenaars. Welkom in Atelier Cuvelier.

programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom makes a journey through the Appalachen, a forgotten and abandoned corner of the US. A mountain range and a region of the same name that, among other things, runs through the States Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina and West-Virginia. In the Appalachen, Tom gets to know a lot of strange Americans who live far away from the big American cities. Each of them leads their own life in one of the most remote areas of America. / Tom maakt een reis doorheen de Appalachen, een vergeten en verlaten uithoek van de VS. Een gebergte en een gelijknamige regio die ondermeer door de staten Tennessee, Kentucky, North-Carolina en West-Virginia loopt. In de Appalachen leert Tom heel wat zonderlinge Amerikanen kennen die ver weg van de grote Amerikaanse steden leven. Elk van hen leidt een heel eigen leven in een van de meest afgelegen gebieden van Amerika.

programme.title: Chantal / Chantal
programme.desc: Andries Vandamme, a moody human hater who lives in a caravan on a piece of land that looks more like a dump, has threatened an inspector of the living inspection with his Tweeloop. During the interrogation, it appears that he himself also has a wound at the head that needs to be taken care of urgently. If his own family wants nothing to do with him anymore, Chantal decides to help the man on track again. To the great displeasure of Cloedt. He knows the man, he is dangerous and antisocial. Chantal waves his warnings in the wind and decides to clean up the caravan with Emma, ​​Pascal and Arne. This way she beats two birds with one stone. She does something again with Arne and she helps a poor loser with it. But then they find a corpse on the grounds of that poor sukkelaar ... / Andries Vandamme, een nukkige mensenhater die in een caravan op een stuk grond woont dat meer weg heeft van een stort, heeft een inspecteur van de wooninspectie bedreigd met zijn tweeloop. Tijdens de ondervraging blijkt dat hij zelf ook een wonde aan het hoofd heeft die dringend moet verzorgd worden. Als zijn eigen familie niets meer met hem te maken wil hebben, besluit Chantal de man opnieuw op de rails te helpen. Tot groot ongenoegen van Cloedt. Hij kent de man, hij is gevaarlijk en asociaal. Chantal wuift zijn waarschuwingen in de wind en besluit om samen met Emma, Pascal en Arne het stort rond de caravan op te kuisen. Zo slaat ze twee vliegen in een klap. Ze doet nog eens iets samen met Arne en ze helpt er een arme sukkelaar mee. Maar dan vinden ze op het terrein van die arme sukkelaar een lijk...

programme.title: Nothing to see / Niks te zien
programme.desc: With Pat Krimson and Loredana, visually impaired Karl Masters pulls the Amicis of Dancefenomena 2 Fabiola to Portugal, not with their eyes but with their ears on sharp. They are introduced to the polyphonic sound of the workers in rural Alentejo, Loredana turns out to be a true fado singer - to the great surprise of Pat - and they discover that even the horses dance to their music in a small southern village. Pat and Loredana close the journey with a new song as a reminder. / Slechtziende Karl Meesters trekt met Pat Krimson en Loredana De Amicis van dancefenomeen 2 Fabiola naar Portugal, niet met hun ogen maar met hun oren op scherp. Ze maken kennis met de meerstemmige klank van de arbeiders in het landelijke Alentejo, Loredana ontpopt zich tot een ware fadozangeres - tot grote verbazing van Pat - en ze ontdekken dat in een klein zuidelijk dorpje zelfs de paarden op hun muziek dansen. Pat en Loredana sluiten de reis af met een nieuw nummer als herinnering.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Francophony destination / Odredište Frankofonije
programme.desc: The "destination of Francophonies" is part of the International Francophone Channel TV5 Mondo and focuses on French and Francophones culture around the world. This edition dedicated to Bosnia and Herzegovina shows local initiatives to promote French and talks with citizens from Sarajevo, Mostar, Banja Luka and Bihac about their love for French and culture. This show served as a platform for strengthening interrelationships and cooperation between Bosnia and Herzegovina and countries in which French is used. / Emisija "Odredište Frankofonije" dio je međunarodnog frankofonog kanala TV5 Monde i fokusira se na francuski jezik i frankofone kulture širom svijeta. Ovo izdanje posvećeno Bosni i Hercegovini prikazuje lokalne inicijative za promociju francuskog jezika i razgovore s građanima iz Sarajeva, Mostara, Banja Luke i Bihaća o njihovoj ljubavi prema francuskom jeziku i kulturi. Ova emisija poslužila ja kao platforma za jačanje međusobnih odnosa i saradnje između Bosne i Hercegovine i zemalja u kojima se koristi francuski jezik.

programme.title: Religious customs of Bosnian Jews / Vjerski običaji bosanskih Jevreja
programme.desc: The reportage record of the Mosaic Religion show, the author of Radovan Pejcinovic of 1994, brings a review of the religious customs of Bosnian Jews in Sarajevo and Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a special emphasis on the Sabbath holidays, Jom Kippur and the Feast of the Tossi. / Reportažni zapis emisije Mozaik religija, autora Radovana Pejčinovića iz 1994. godine, donosi osvrt na vjerske običaje bosanskih Jevreja u Sarajevu i Bosni i Hercegovini, s posebnim naglaskom na blagdane Šabat, Jom Kipur i blagdan Sjenica.

programme.title: View of the soul / Pogled u dušu
programme.desc: The Museum of the Jews of BiH, located in the old part of Sarajevo, visit numerous tourists every day. The museum, ie the oldest synagogue in Bosnia and Herzegovina, opens the door to the religious rite once a year _ Celebrating Roš Hashan _ Jewish New Year. Reportage "View in the soul" will come to you how to celebrate Roš Hashan, which are the features of a ritual dinner, and a rich Sephardic tradition. Roš Hashana is a "head of the year," a new beginning, which precedes the month of prayer and introspection. "View in the soul" is a view of the past and a review of the present and guardians of tradition. Avica Vesna Smital / Muzej Jevreja BiH, koji se nalazi u starom dijelu Sarajeva, svakodnevno posjećuju brojni turisti. Muzej, odnosno najstarija sinagoga u Bosni i Hercegovini, jednom godišnje otvara vrata za vjerski obred _ proslavu Roš hašana _ jevrejske Nove godine. Reportaža "Pogled u dušu" dočaraće vam kako se slavi Roš hašana, koje su osobenosti obredne večere, te bogatu sefardsku tradiciju. Roš hašana je "glava godine", novi početak, kojem prethodi mjesec molitve i introspekcija. "Pogled u dušu" je pogled u prošlost i osvrt na sadašnjost i čuvare tradicije.Autorica Vesna Smital

programme.title: Word by word / Riječ po riječ
programme.desc: Eleventh-year-old Eliza feels neglected in his family. Her parents Miriam and Saul are so dedicated to work to ignore marital problems, and Eliza's brother, talented musician, lives in his artistic world. With a victory in the eliza competition, he drives a whole range of events. Delighted with daughter's talent, Saul fully devotes her in desire to make a national champion from her, but at the same time he moves away from his son and wife. As a professor of the religious learning of Kabbala, based on the basis of interpreting numbers and letters, salvation from problems and the crisis of faith, Saul finds in Eliza's success. The son of Aaron, meanwhile, rejects Jewish learning and passes to Hinduism, and Miriam cannot find peace after the car accident in which her parents were killed. / Jedanaestogodišnja Eliza osjeća se zapostavljeno u svojoj porodici. Njeni roditelji Miriam i Saul toliko su posvećeni poslu da ignorišu bračne probleme, a Elizin brat, talentirani muzičar, živi u svom umjetničkom svijetu. Pobjedom na takmičenju Eliza pokreće cijeli niz događaja. Oduševljen kćerinim talentom, Saul joj se potpuno posveti u želji da od nje napravi nacionalnu prvakinju, no istovremeno se udaljava od sina i supruge. Kao profesor religijskog učenja kabale, koja se temelji na osnovi tumačenja brojeva i slova, spas od problema i krizu vjere, Saul pronalazi u Elizinom uspjehu. Sin Aaron, u međuvremenu, odbacuje židovsko učenje i prelazi na hinduizam, a Miriam ne može naći mir nakon automobilske nesreće u kojoj su joj roditelji poginuli.

programme.title: Nova Avantura / Nova avantura
programme.desc: Luznjak Oak once represented an economically important species of trees of Bosnia and Herzegovina forests. However, since 1907, the professional literature states that there are only the remains of once large forest complexes in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The fundamental reason for this condition is that the forests of the oak of Lužnjak have been completely marginalized in the last hundred years, both from the scientific point of view and due to agricultural activities, until their complete devastation from 1839 to 1913. Today, in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the oak Luznjak can be found in mixed forests, mainly in Ravnice, Valley Valley, and some of our mountain plateaus. / Hrast lužnjak je nekada predstavljao ekonomski važnu vrstu drveća bosanskohercegovačkih šuma. Ipak, od 1907. godine u stručnoj literaturi navodi se da u Bosni i Hercegovini postoje samo ostaci nekada velikih šumskih kompleksa. Temeljni razlog za ovo stanje je što su šume hrasta lužnjaka u posljednjih stotinu godina potpuno marginalizovane, kako sa naučnog stanovišta, tako i usljed poljoprivrednih aktivnosti, sve do njihove potpune devastacije od 1839. do 1913. godine. Danas, u Bosni i Hercegovini hrast lužnjak možemo pronaći u mješovitim šumama, uglavnom u ravnicama, dolinama velikih rijeka, te nekim od naših planinskih visoravni.

U saradnji sa Radio Slobodna Evropa, The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Udruženjem "Obrazovanje gradi BiH", producent je Mebius Film. Prva epizoda je objavljena u februaru 2015. godine.

programme.desc: The view to the future is an international TV show that brings us interesting reports and documentaries about different topics. / Pogled u budućnost je međunarodna TV emisija koja nam donosi zanimljive reportaže i dokumentarne filmove o različitim temama.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Religious customs of Bosnian Jews / Vjerski običaji bosanskih Jevreja
programme.desc: The reportage record of the Mosaic Religion show, the author of Radovan Pejcinovic of 1994, brings a review of the religious customs of Bosnian Jews in Sarajevo and Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a special emphasis on the Sabbath holidays, Jom Kippur and the Feast of the Tossi. / Reportažni zapis emisije Mozaik religija, autora Radovana Pejčinovića iz 1994. godine, donosi osvrt na vjerske običaje bosanskih Jevreja u Sarajevu i Bosni i Hercegovini, s posebnim naglaskom na blagdane Šabat, Jom Kipur i blagdan Sjenica.

programme.title: View of the soul / Pogled u dušu
programme.desc: The Museum of the Jews of BiH, located in the old part of Sarajevo, visit numerous tourists every day. The museum, ie the oldest synagogue in Bosnia and Herzegovina, opens the door to the religious rite once a year _ Celebrating Roš Hashan _ Jewish New Year. Reportage "View in the soul" will come to you how to celebrate Roš Hashan, which are the features of a ritual dinner, and a rich Sephardic tradition. Roš Hashana is a "head of the year," a new beginning, which precedes the month of prayer and introspection. "The view in the soul" is a view in the past and a review of the present and guardian of the tradition. / Muzej Jevreja BiH, koji se nalazi u starom dijelu Sarajeva, svakodnevno posjećuju brojni turisti. Muzej, odnosno najstarija sinagoga u Bosni i Hercegovini, jednom godišnje otvara vrata za vjerski obred _ proslavu Roš hašana _ jevrejske Nove godine. Reportaža "Pogled u dušu" dočaraće vam kako se slavi Roš hašana, koje su osobenosti obredne večere, te bogatu sefardsku tradiciju. Roš hašana je "glava godine", novi početak, kojem prethodi mjesec molitve i introspekcija. "Pogled u dušu" je pogled u prošlost i osvrt na sadašnjost i čuvare tradicije.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Thinking Box / Thinking Box
programme.desc: Turn your brain with the Thinking Box! This show, designed for young people, encourages thinking outside the frame of everyday. Special focus puts on the promotion of young artists and talented girls and young men from all over Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Uključi mozak uz Thinking Box! Ova emisija, osmišljena za mlade, potiče razmišljanje izvan okvira svakodnevice. Poseban fokus stavlja na promociju mladih umjetnika i talentovanih djevojaka i mladića iz svih krajeva Bosne i Hercegovine.

programme.title: BHT 1 live / BHT 1 uživo
programme.desc: The motto of BHT 1 show is "News Plus". In the show Information, Analysis, Predictions and Backgrounds of the event. Experts, analysts and citizens speak for BHT 1 live. Comments about what is being talked about on social networks, and analysis of the topic of the day. Part of the contents of the show are reports of lesser known places, but also the stories of the beautiful and unusual areas of our country, as well as valuable and interesting people. / Moto emisije BHT 1 uživo je "Vijest plus". U emisiji informacije, analize, predviđanja i pozadina događaja. Za BHT 1 uživo govore stručnjaci, analitičari i građani. Komentari o čemu se priča na društvenim mrežama, i analiza teme dana. Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Guendalina Said to Albert that the next day Lucches would go to Turin and persuade him to follow him to discover his secret and use it against him in the election campaign in which they are on opposite sides. Alberto hesitates, but still listens to his wife's advice, although his path will not introduce the results that Guandalina wanted. Alessandro informs Silvia that Brand's treatment is going in the right direction. On the same evening, Ms. Corradi made a painful decision. She will not participate in a charity dinner organized by her mother -in -law. / Guendalina saopštava Albertu da će narednog dana Lucchesi ići u Torino i nagovara ga da ga slijedi kako bi otkrio njegovu tajnu i iskoristio je protiv njega u izbornoj kampanji u kojoj se nalaze na suprotnim stranama. Alberto oklijeva, no ipak posluša savjet svoje žene, iako njegov put neće iznjedriti rezultate kakve je Guendalina priželjkivala. Alessandro obavještava Silviju da Brandovo liječenje ide u dobrom smjeru. Iste večeri gđa Corradi donese bolnu odluku. Neće sudjelovati u dobrotvornoj večeri koju organizira njena svekrva.

programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day, they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they solve all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Civil corner / Građanski ugao
programme.desc: How about the 90s teaching in schools in Montenegro and the region? What is the teaching of history at all and what the chances of teaching are adapted to the standards of developed democratic society, to be deprived of ethnocentricity and encourage a critical way of thinking. Through these topics, through an example of common historical textbooks, Igor Radulović, Professor of history, Professor of History, the Faculty of Philosophy, Ana Radaković, the Faculty of Philosophy, Professor at the Faculty of Philosophy, University of Philosophy Sarajevo. The show will also show a documentary on how these textbooks, translated into 11 languages ​​of the region, arose, as historians from all countries have agreed on the content of books that is the same for all countries, in all languages. / Kako se o 90-im uči u školama u Crnoj Gori i regionu? Kakva je uopšte nastava istorije i kakve su šanse da se ta nastava prilagodi standardima razvijenog demokratskog društva, da bude lišena etnocentričnosti i da podstiče kritički način razmišljanja. Na ove teme, kroz primjer Zajedničkih istorijskih čitanki za 13 zemalja Jugoistočne Evrope govoriće, Igor Radulović, profesor istorije iz Podgorice, Branimr Janković, profesor istorije na Filozofskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, Ana Radaković, istraživačica na Instituta za savremenu istoriju u Beogradu i Amir Duranović, profesor istorije na Filozofskom fakultetu Univerziteta u Sarajevu. U emisiji će biti prikazan i dokumentarni film o tome kako su te čitanke, prevedene na 11 jezika regiona, nastale, kako su se istoričari iz svih zemalja usaglasili u vezi sa sadržajem knjiga koji je isti za sve zemlje, na svim jezicima.

programme.title: The game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Altan finally shows Aziza a diary he found and Aziz realizes that it is a diary of his nana nadide. It will find many answers for their concerns. Just when he thinks that he is on his way to solving all the problems he has found himself, he learns that Feride is in danger. Will Aziz have to choose between the life of his sister Sultan and Feride? / Altan konačno pokazuje Azizu dnevnik koji je pronašao i Aziz shvata da je to dnevnik njegove nane Nadide. U njemu će pronaći mnoge odgovore za svoje nedoumice. Baš kada pomisli da je na putu da riješi sve probleme pred kojima se našao, saznaje da je i Feride u opasnosti. Hoće li Aziz morati birati između života svoje sestre Sultan i Feride?

programme.desc: The National Basketball Association (in English: National Basketball Association, NBA), abbreviated NBA, is the most prestigious world male professional basketball league and among the 4 main professional sports leagues in North America. It was established on June 6, 1946 in New York under the name American Basketball Association (ABA). He received his new name in the fall of 1949 after the unification with the US National Basketball League (NBL). The two most successful NBA teams are Los Angeles Lacos and Boston Celtics, who have won the title 17 times. Other teams became champions are: Golden State Warriors (7), Chicago Bulls (6), San Antonio Spurs (5), Philadelphia 76 (7 (1), Washington Waerds (1), Atlanta Hawks (1), Oklahoma Tander (1), Portland Trail Blazers (2), Baltimore Ballets (1), Dallas Maverix (1), Toronto Raptters (1), Denver Nugets (1) / Националната баскетболна асоциация (на английски: National Basketball Association, NBA), съкратено НБА, е най-престижната световна мъжка професионална баскетболна лига и сред 4-те основни професионални спортни лиги на Северна Америка. Създадена е на 6 юни 1946 г. в Ню Йорк под името Американска баскетболна асоциация (АБА). Получава новото си име през есента на 1949 г. след обединението с Националната баскетболна лига на САЩ (НБЛ). Двата най-успешни отбора в НБА са Лос Анджелис Лейкъс и Бостън Селтикс, които са печелили титлата по 17 пъти. Други отбори ставали шампиони са: Голдън Стейт Уориърс (7), Чикаго Булс (6), Сан Антонио Спърс (5), Филаделфия 76 (7), Детрйт Пистънс (3), Маями Хийт (3), Ню Йорк Никс (2), Хюстън Рокитс (2), Милуоки Бъкс (2), Кливлънд Кавалиърс (1), Уошингтън Уизърдс (1), Атланта Хоукс (1), Оклахома Тъндър (1), Портланд Трейл Блейзърс (2), Балтимор Булетс (1), Далас Маверикс (1), Торонто Раптърс (1), Денвър Нъгетс (1) и Рочестър Ройълс (1).

programme.desc: The English Premier League, also known as the Premier League or Premiership, is the highest level division in English football. The Premier League is the most watched Sports League and the richest championship in the world. The race was founded in 1888 as the First Division and transformed in 1992 as the Premier League. The founders of the First Division in 1888 are Akrington, Aston Villa, Blackburn, Bolton, Burnley, Darby K, Everton, Wolverhampton, Stoke C, West Bromic, Nots K and Preston. The most successful teams are: Manchester Yu, Liverpool, Arsenal, Everton, Manchester with, Aston Villa, Sunderland and Chelsea. / Английската Висша лига, известна още като Премиър лига или Премиършип (Premier League или Premiership), е дивизията от най-високо ниво в английския футбол. Висшата лига е най-гледаната спортна лига и най-богатото първенство в света. Надпреварата е основана през 1888 като Първа дивизия и трансформирана през 1992 като Висша лига. Основатели на Първа дивизия през 1888 са Акрингтън, Астън Вила, Блекбърн, Болтън, Бърнли, Дарби К, Евертън, Уулвърхамптън, Стоук С, Уест Бромич, Нотс К и Престън. programme.title: Love, exclusively / Ljubav, ekskluzivno
programme.desc: Love Exclusively-(movie, USA, 2017) Music-Romantic Comedy in which a tabloid journalist, longing for the cover, tries to write an exclusive story about the two pop-stars with whom she went to school ... Allie tries to obtain such a good story that the editor puts her on the cover, but that is not going to her. He sees his great opportunity in the story of the alleged love affair between the two popular stars, Carson Peet and Caleb Greene. There are several obstacles in this plan, and one of them is that Caleb was her quiet suffering at school, and it was increasingly clearer that he could become it again. The second, professional, is that Caleb and Carson are just working in business and there is nothing between them, but manager Vivian asks to talk as bombastic as possible, so that their popularity, even the sale of the CD, even greater ... Peet), Tommy Savas (Matty Sellers), Lindsay Hartley (Vivian Cartwright) ... / Love Exclusively - (film, SAD, 2017) Glazbeno-romantična komedija u kojoj novinarka tabloida, žudeći za naslovnicom, pokušava napisati eksluzivnu priču o dvjema pop-zvijezdama s kojima je išla u školu... Allie pokušava pribaviti tako dobru priču da je urednik stavi na naslovnicu, no to joj baš ne ide. Svoju veliku priliku vidi u priči o navodnoj ljubavnoj vezi između dviju popularnih zvijezda, Carson Peet i Caleba Greenea. U tom naumu ima nekoliko zapreka, a jedna od njih je što je Caleb u školi bio njezina tiha patnja, a sve je jasnije da bi to mogao opet postati. Druga, profesionalna, jest što Caleb i Carson samo surađuju u poslu i ničega nema između njih, no menadžerica Vivian traži da priča bude što bombastičnija, kako bi njihova popularnost, pa i prodaja CD-a bila još veća... programme.title: Call Babic / Zovite babicu
programme.desc: Call The Midwife - (S01, E01, Drama series, England, 2012) touching, intimate, humorous and primarily a realistic account of mid -and family life in East London in the 1950s, based on the extremely popular memoir of the late Jennifer Worth. When he arrives in the repayment, young midwife Jenny Lee knows almost nothing about poverty, problems - not even about his life. He soon begins to collaborate with nunnatus nuns, nursing nuns, and joins the midwifery team that provide pregnant women's care - especially those from the poorest districts. The streets are full of children here, and since the maternity ward has only eight beds, most childbirth is at home. Jenny visits pregnant women and maternity women on the bike, meeting characters like Conchite, who is pregnant 25th time, and Mary, a fifteen -year -old prostitute who wears her first child. The Call The Midwife series brings a fascinating view of the community on the threshold of great social changes. ------- Spring is 1957. Jenny Lee, just a midwife graduate, comes to East London. After the initial shock when she discovers that her new home is actually a monastery, not a private clinic, she gradually gets used to life with nuns and working in a community full of peculiar characters - including Conchitu Warren, who expects the 25th child. With Jenny, we will experience all the joy and challenges that the midwife job brings. According to memoirs: Jennifer Wort R .: Philippa Lowthorpe Ul.: Jessica Raine (Jenny Lee), Patim Ferris (Sister Evangelina), Helen George (Trixie Franklin), Laura Main (Sister Bernadette), Judy perfutt (Sister Monica Joan) ... / Call the Midwife - (S01, E01, dramska serija, Engleska, 2012) Dirljiv, intiman, duhovit i ponajprije realističan prikaz života primalja i obitelji u istočnom Londonu 1950-ih, temeljen na iznimno popularnim memoarima pokojne Jennifer Worth. Kada stiže u Poplar, mlada primalja Jenny Lee ne zna gotovo ništa o siromaštvu, problemima - pa ni o samom životu. Uskoro počinje surađivati s časnim sestrama iz kuće Nonnatus, redovnicama koje se bave sestrinstvom, i pridružuje se timu primalja koje pružaju skrb trudnicama - osobito onima iz najsiromašnijih četvrti. Ovdje su ulice pune djece, a budući da rodilište ima samo osam kreveta, većina porođaja odvija se kod kuće. Jenny na biciklu obilazi trudnice i rodilje, upoznajući likove poput Conchite, koja je trudna 25. put, i Mary, petnaestogodišnje prostitutke koja nosi svoje prvo dijete. Serija Call the Midwife donosi fascinantan prikaz zajednice na pragu velikih društvenih promjena. ------- Proljeće je 1957. godine. Jenny Lee, tek diplomirana primalja, dolazi u istočni London. Nakon početnog šoka kad otkriva da je njezin novi dom zapravo samostan, a ne privatna klinika, postupno se privikava na život s časnim sestrama i rad u zajednici prepunoj osebujnih likova - uključujući Conchitu Warren, koja očekuje 25. dijete. Uz Jenny ćemo iskusiti sve radosti i izazove koje donosi posao primalje. Prema memoarima: Jennifer Wort R.: Philippa Lowthorpe Ul.: Jessica Raine (Jenny Lee), Pam Ferris (Sister Evangelina), Helen George (Trixie Franklin), Laura Main (Sister Bernadette), Judy Parfitt (Sister Monica Joan)...

programme.title: The largest performance in the world / Najveća predstava na svijetu
programme.desc: The Greatest Show on Earth - (Drama, USA, 1952) spectacle. In order to ensure a lucrative season for his circus, Director Brad Braden (C. Heston) hires a trapezist of the great Sebastian (C. Wilde) as the main star. This is a very hit by Brad's girlfriend Holly (B. Hutton), an excellent trapezist who wants to be the main in the point at all costs. By securing a joint performance, Holly and Sebastian will constantly compete ... "The biggest play in the world" is a great spectacle of the famed director Cecil B. de Mille (Ten Commandments, Cleopatra), an exciting movie full of lavish scenes, glittering costumes, songs and dance. In addition to Zoran, almost documentary, circus life, the film also brings the excellent story about the rivalry of two artists, the complex relationship of the circus owner with associates, etc. In the film, famous American actors C. Heston, B. Hutton, C. Wilde, J. Stewart. In 1952, the movie won the Oscar for Best Picture and is still one of the most expensive Hollywood films of all time. R.: Cecil B. Demille Ul.: Charlton Heston (Brad Braden), Betty Hutton (Holly), Cornel Wilde (Great Sebastian), James Stewart (Buttons), Gloria Grahame (Angel) ... / The Greatest Show on Earth - (drama, SAD, 1952) Spektakl. Ne bi li osigurao unosnu sezonu za svoj cirkus, direktor Brad Braden (C. Heston) angažira trapezista Velikog Sebastiana (C. Wilde) kao glavnu zvijezdu. To jako pogodi Bradovu djevojku Holly (B. Hutton), izvrsnu trapezisticu koja pod svaku cijenu želi biti glavna u točki. Osiguravši im zajednički nastup, Holly i Sebastian stalno će se tijekom izvođenja natjecati... "Najveća predstava na svijetu" sjajan je spektakl glasovitoga redatelja Cecila B. de Millea (Deset Zapovijedi, Kleopatra), uzbudljiv film pun raskošnih scena, blještavih kostima, pjesme i plesa. Uz zoran prikaz, gotovo dokumentaristički, cirkuskoga života, film donosi i izvrsnu priču o suparništvu dvoje artista, o složenom odnosu vlasnika cirkusa sa suradnicima itd. U filmu glume slavni američki glumci C. Heston, B. Hutton, C. Wilde, J. Stewart. Film je 1952. osvojio Oscara za najbolji film i još je uvijek jedan od najskupljih hollywoodskih filmova svih vremena. programme.title: Blessed among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: Blessed Among Women - (S01, E01, SUM series, Croatia, 2025) "This is a story from everyday life in which many viewers will be recognized, the emphasis is on a family warmth that mixes with humor, so I expect positive audience reactions. So far I have been going well with this and I believe it will be the case this time. This and the audience recognize, "points out the author and director of the series Goran Kulenovic. The series of the series revolves around a single father - Purger on the threshold of his 50s and at the position of head of the Harbor Master's Office in Split - after the dedicated years, who he dedicated to raising and upbringing two daughters, whom his fugitive wife left him for care while still girls, tries to live again "her life." After the older daughter of Maja, a psychologist, married Belgrade and hired, and younger Daria enrolled in college and moved to the Student Dom - Blaž Živković aka nerve, he thought it had come "his five minutes", that is, time to find a soulmate and enjoys life with full lungs. However, this is shown as an impossible mission. The daughters, with another surprise, return to Blaise's life again, complicating his chatty neighbor Spiro, an Ankica saleswoman who suffers quietly, a peculiar grandmother Bjanka, a Conservative grandfather Vjeran, the Postaire Torcidaš Elvis and Majin left Belgrade's husband ... Pilic, Mia Bujan, Sarah Parisi, Doris Saric Kukuljica, Lana Baric, Ivica Zadro, Stipe Radoja, Slavica Knezevic, Djordje Kukuljica, Sava Stojanovic, Branimir Rakic ​​and many others, excellent actors. "I play a single father who fed his daughters and tried to let life become independent, and then a combination of different circumstances realized that he thought it had come" his five minutes "to live a little more, his adult daughter returned to life. / Blaž među ženama - (S01, E01, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) " Ovo je priča iz svakodnevnog života u kojem će se moći prepoznati mnogobrojni gledatelji, naglasak je na obiteljskoj toplini koja se miješa sa humorom pa očekujem pozitivne reakcije publike. Do sada sam s tim dobro prolazio i vjerujem da će to tako biti i ovaj put. Svi koji su čitali scenarij slažu se da imamo dobar i zabavan scenarij pa vjerujem da će to i publika prepoznati", ističe autor i redatelj serije Goran Kulenović. Radnja serije se vrti oko samohranog oca - purgera na pragu svojih 50-ih i na poziciji šefa Lučke kapetanije u Splitu - poslije pustih godina kojih je posvetio podizanju i odgoju dvije kćeri koje mu je odbjegla supruga ostavila na brigu dok su bile još djevojčice, nastoji ponovno živjeti "svoj život". Nakon što se starija kći Maja, psihologinja, udala u Beograd i tamo zaposlila, a mlađa Daria upisala faks i odselila u studentski dom - Blaž Živković zvani Živac, smatra da je došlo "njegovih pet minuta", odnosno vrijeme da si pronađe srodnu dušu i uživa život punim plućima. Međutim, to se pokazuje kao nemoguća misija. Kćeri se, uz još jedno iznenađenje, ponovo vraćaju u Blažev život, koji mu kompliciraju i brbljavi susjed Špiro, prodavačica Ankica koja za Blažem potiho pati, osebujna baka Bjanka, konzervativni djed Vjeran, prostodušni torcidaš Elvis te Majin ostavljeni beogradski suprug... Glumačku postavu predvode Marko Makovičić, Marija Škaričić, Slavko Sobin, Luna Pilić, Mia Bujan, Sara Parisi, Doris Šarić Kukuljica, Lana Barić, Ivica Zadro, Stipe Radoja, Slavica Knežević, Đorđe Kukuljica, Sava Stojanović, Branimir Rakić i mnogi drugi, izvrsni glumci. "Igram samohranog oca koji je othranio svoje kćeri i koje je pokušao pustiti u život da se osamostale, a onda spletom različitih okolnosti shvati taman kad je mislio da je došlo "njegovih pet minuta" da malo još proživi,odrasle kćeri mu se vrate u život. Veselim se kad će serija ugledati televizijske ekrane i vjerujem da će gledatelji...

programme.title: A cloud in the service of the law / Oblak u službi zakona
programme.desc: A cloud in the service of the law - (S03, E03, SUM series, Croatia, 2025) After the success, you will be resting, you deserved, screenwriters Snježana and Goran Tribuson prepared a new treat, a family humorous series - a cloud in the law of the law. It is a combination of family series with a slight crime plot, because Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), the head of the Oblak family, is a police sergeant. He is an idealist and honesty who believes in some human values ​​and often recognizes them where they are gone. Unlike Nikola, other members of the Oblak family are far more realistic and more prone to procedures that, although benign, are on the verge of law. Nikola's wife Strawberry (Dijana Vidusin) cannot find a job, and in order to contribute to a small home budget, she often resorts to black work. Creative, curious, somewhat self -sacrificing, devoted herself to Nicholas and children and is the complete opposite of neighbors, butcher shops (Ksenija Marinkovic). Two of their sons, Bruno (Toma Medvesek) and Ratko (Borna Fadljevic), adolescents, are a source of many problems. The younger, Ratko, intellectually superior to everyone in the house while for the elder Bruno, who is by no means finished school, could not say that. Most of the time Bruno spends in a local birtia near Suvi (Zoran Cubrilo) and Ludviga (Goran Navojec) who, although older, do not differ too much from him. Different characters and preferences of family members are a source of humorous situations and complications, and in every episode Nikola is resolved by one criminal case: a kiosk breakthrough, a car theft, a breakthrough of the Kindergarten, a small fraud ... but although in the business a more successful, more intelligent and better police officer than his partner Pozgaja (Igor Mesin) Police tasks, as well as from the head of Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), in no way progressing in the police hierarchy ... R .: Dražen Žarković Ul.: Dijana Vidušin, Igor Mesin, Goran Navojec, Zoran Cubrilo, Hrvoje Barisic (Director of the Old House) ... / Oblak u službi zakona - (S03, E03, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon uspješnice Odmori se, zaslužio si, scenaristi Snježana i Goran Tribuson pripremili su nam novu poslasticu, obiteljsku humorističnu seriju - Oblak u službi zakona. Spoj je to obiteljske serije s laganim krimi zapletom, jer Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), glava obitelji Oblak, policijski je narednik. Idealist je i poštenjačina koji vjeruje u neke ljudske vrijednosti te ih nerijetko prepoznaje i tamo gdje ih nema. Za razliku od Nikole, drugi članovi obitelji Oblak daleko su realističniji i skloniji postupcima koji su, iako benigni, na rubu zakonitosti. Nikolina žena Jagoda (Dijana Vidušin) ne može naći posao, a kako bi pridonijela ionako malom kućnom budžetu, često pribjegava radu na crno. Kreativna, znatiželjna, pomalo samozatajna, posvetila se Nikoli i djeci te je potpuna suprotnost susjedi, mesarici Greti (Ksenija Marinković). Dvojica njihovih sinova, Bruno (Toma Medvešek) i Ratko (Borna Fadljević), adolescenti, izvor su mnogih problema. Mlađi, Ratko, intelektualno je nadmoćan svima u kući dok se za starijeg Brunu, koji nikako da završi školu, to ne bi moglo reći. Većinu vremena Bruno provodi u lokalnoj birtiji kod Suvog (Zoran Čubrilo) i Ludviga (Goran Navojec) koji se, iako stariji, ne razlikuju previše od njega. Različiti karakteri i sklonosti članova obitelji Oblak izvor su humornih situacija i zapleta, a u svakoj epizodi Nikola rješava i jedan kriminalistički slučaj: provalu u kiosk, krađu automobila, provalu u kvartovski dječji vrtić, sitne prevare... No iako u poslu uspješan, inteligentniji i bolji policajac od svog partnera Požgaja (Igor Mešin) koji ima široku lepezu interesa pa se rijetko stigne posvetiti policijskim zadaćama, kao i od šefa Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), nikako da napreduje u policijskoj hijerarhiji... R.: Dražen Žarković Ul.: Dijana Vidušin, Igor Mešin, Goran Navojec, Zoran Čubrilo, Hrvoje Barišić (Direktor starackog doma)...

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: We were born on Morava - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2018) on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Salamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure - "Croatian wedding", choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the National Costumes of Moravian Croats. Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. Expert associate: Vido Bagur R .: Davor Boric ... / Rodili smo se na Moravi - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2018) U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago - "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E39, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E39, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Herbs / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: Plane hunter - (S03, E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2021) "Plague Hunter" is a unique adventure documentary series that speaks to Croatian natural wealth and herbs in an educational and attractive way. Mentor Anton Rudan, also better known as an enthusiastic herb hunter, seeks and discovers a wild, autochthonous and alohtono plant at spectacular locations across Croatia. Numerous plant species, as well as all their accompanying and beneficial values ​​in health, in gastronomy, sources of drinking and quality water, climate and landscape diversity, are the basis of each of the 12 episodes. Through the "Rudan" series "Rudan hunter" is also encountered with many challenges and adventurous, extreme situations through which we are introduced to the various ends whose help often reveals different types of plants, referring to the history of a particular site and their relationships with plants and, of course, preserving their natural heritage. In the time of increasing environmental awareness, the theme of the "Hunter on herbs" offers viewers and a kind of invitation and motivation for independent but accessible research the middle. In addition, improving the quality of your own life, the rules of conduct and navigation in nature, as well as actively spending free time with minimal expense, which does not require distant travel, will be additional motivation to viewers of this series, created and realized solely in domestic production. Voditelj Anton Rudan, poznatiji i kao entuzijastični Lovac na bilje, traži i otkriva samoniklo, autohtono i alohtono bilje na spektakularnim lokacijama širom Hrvatske. Mnogobrojne biljne vrste, kao i sve njihove popratne i blagotvorne vrijednosti što u zdravlju, što u gastronomiji, izvori pitke i kvalitetne vode, klimatska i krajobrazna raznolikost, temelj su svake od 12 epizoda.Kroz seriju "Lovac na bilje" Rudan se susreće i s mnogim izazovima te avanturističkim, ekstremnim situacijama putem kojih nas upoznaje s različitim krajevima i mještanima, inače specijaliziranim stručnjacima, uz čiju pomoć nerijetko razotkriva različite vrste bilja, pritom se referirajući na povijest pojedinog lokaliteta te njihovog odnosa s biljkama i, dakako, očuvanjem njihove prirodne baštine.U vrijeme sve veće ekološke osviještenosti, tematika serije "Lovac na bilje" nudi gledateljima i svojevrsnu pozivnicu te motivaciju za samostalno, ali pristupačno istraživanje i uvid u netaknutu prirodu koja se nalazi nadomak urbanih sredina. Uz to, poboljšanje kvalitete vlastitog života, pravila ponašanja i snalaženja u prirodi, kao i aktivno provođenje slobodnog vremena uz minimalan trošak, koje ne iziskuje daleka putovanja, bit će dodatna motivacija gledateljima ove serije, kreirane i realizirane isključivo u domaćoj produkciji. programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: We were born on Morava - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2018) on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Salamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure - "Croatian wedding", choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the National Costumes of Moravian Croats. Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. R .: Davor Boric ... / Rodili smo se na Moravi - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2018) U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago - "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova. programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2025) Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. R .: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E02, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta. R.: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E39, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E39, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown - (S10, E02, known. Pop. Series, USA, 2017) Gloves were thrown and rivalry continued while Bourdain and his longtime friend, chef with three Michelin stars Éric Ripert, start traveling with French Alps, filled with skiing and cheese. Bourdain gains the impression of Rypert's young days, while he approaches the cows too much and exaggerates with delicious cheese dishes. programme.title: Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje

Vidjet ćemo kako mladi poljoprivrednici, oslanjajući se na tradiciju, mogu stvoriti inovativne modele poslovanja i otvoriti nova vrata gastronomiji. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Urban and 4 and HRT Symphony Orchestra, Arena Zagreb, Part 2 / Urban and 4 i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, Arena Zagreb, 2. dio
programme.desc: Urban and 4 and the HRT Symphony Orchestra, Arena Zagreb, 2nd part - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2023), about eight thousand people gathered in the Zagreb Arena to testify to more than three decades of Damir Urban's long career, summarized in 23 songs for most arranged by Ante Gelo. The choice was covered by Urban's creativity from the first half of the 1990s and the Laufer band (with a legendary song Being My Water) through solo projects until today. Nine months after the enchanting concert of Urban and 4 and the HRT Symphony Orchestra on Prisavlje, held as part of the sunny side of Prisavlje, the same band impressed in the Zagreb Arena on June 10, 2023. (keyboards) - and the HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Alan Bjelinsky, this time they performed even more songs and more strongly amazed with their synergy ... / Urban and 4 i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, Arena Zagreb, 2. dio - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2023) Oko osam tisuća ljudi okupilo se u zagrebačkoj Areni kako bi svjedočilo više od tri desetljeća dugoj karijeri Damira Urbana, sažetoj u 23 pjesme za koje je većinu aranžmana napravio Ante Gelo. Izbor je obuhvatio Urbanovo stvaralaštvo od prve polovice 1990-ih i sastava Laufer (s legendarnom pjesmom Budi moja voda) preko solo projekata pa sve do danas. Devet mjeseci nakon očaravajućeg koncerta Urban and 4 i Simfonijskog orkestra HRT-a na Prisavlju, održanog u sklopu Sunčane strane Prisavlja, isti sastav impresionirao je i u zagrebačkoj Areni 10. lipnja 2023. Damir Urban i njegova Četvorka - Luka Toman (gitara), Marko Bradaschia (bubnjevi), Sandi Bratonja (bas gitara, harmonika) i Saša Markovski (klavijature) - te Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Alana Bjelinskog, ovaj su put izveli još više pjesama i još snažnije zadivili svojom sinergijom...

George Michael bio je poznat po hitovima koji su osvajali vrhove top-ljestvica i po turbulentnom privatnom životu. Sukobi sa zakonom i ovisnost o drogama počeli su zasjenjivati njegovu glazbenu karijeru. Postoje mnoge nedoumice o njegovoj smrti. Posljednjih desetak godina života imao je zdravstvenih problema, ali slava je prouzročila njegov slom. She has full hands of work, starting with Mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who is well-meaning but choke him, through the temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to the rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orranti) and the hypersensible brother Barry (Troy Gentile). Driving watches, first jobs, applications for college and acquiring new friends without losing their old ones, it's all part of the Goldberg family. programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2025) Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. R .: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E02, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta. R.: Olly Scholey Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: Croatian water treasure / Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Croatian Water Treasure - (S02, E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) Many Zagreb residents and their guests will be surprised by the hidden gentle of a good spirit that watches over a million city. He will tell us some of his stories of history, legends, the richness of the plant and animal world. Back in 1242, Bela IV. He donated the name of Medvednica on the city of Zagreb. Later, at the time of absolutism, they called her Zagreb. It was inhabited by some of our ancient ancestors back in prehistoric times, and for centuries of exploitation of all its wealth, especially water and forests, they made a modern civilization that in 1981 it was declared a nature park. Much more than the shady up in the north, these are Zagreb lungs and a place to rest and fun that hide the veterans and her bats, mines, five hundred Horvat stairs, mountaineering homes and chapels in their womb. And the stories of ancient history, those spoken in Zagreb - about the Black Queen and a treasure buried under the ancient Medvedgrad and those spoken in the Croatian Zagorje - about stone from the Svati and Peasant Revolt. And water ... water flowing under the canopy of Sljemes and leaving peacefully to the north - to Zagorje, and to the south - to Zagreb, bring life to everything, even the farthest and darkest corner of Medvednica. R .: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator) ... / Hrvatsko vodeno blago - (S02, E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) Mnogi će se Zagrepčani i njihovi gosti iznenaditi skrivenim blagom dobroga duha koji bdije iznad milijunskoga grada. Ispričat će nam dio njegovih priča o povijesti, legendama, bogatstvu biljnog i životinjskog svijeta. Još davne 1242. godine Bela IV. darovao je gradu Zagrebu posjed na gori imena Medvednica. Poslije su je, u vrijeme apsolutizma, nazvali Zagrebačkom gorom. Naseljavali su je neki naši davni preci još u pretpovijesno doba, a stoljeća iskorištavanja svih njezinih bogatstava, posebice voda i šuma, nagnali su modernu civilizaciju da je 1981. proglasi parkom prirode. Mnogo više od sjenovite gore na sjeveru, ova su zagrebačka pluća i mjesto za odmor i zabavu koja u svojoj utrobi skrivaju Veternicu i njezine šišmiše, rudnike, pet stotina Horvatovih stuba, planinarske domove i kapelice. I priče o drevnoj povijesti, one koje se pričaju u Zagrebu - o Crnoj Kraljici i blagu zakopanu pod drevnim Medvedgradom te one koje se pričaju u Hrvatskom zagorju - o Kamenim svatima i Seljačkoj buni. I vode... Vode koje izviru pod krošnjama sljemenskim i odlaze mirnim tokom prema sjeveru - u Zagorje, te prema jugu - u Zagreb, donose život u sve, pa i najudaljenije i najtamnije kutke Medvednice. R.: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator)...

Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete.
